description:
Intent i018 (SNAPSHOT=s05, BRANCH=alloc-multiply-overflow) complete. Final artifact: /mnt/raid/home/yangshuangning/vuln_variant_search/experiments/clairvoyant_variant_search/runs/10_cluster/C9/agent-state/findings/i018.json.

FINDING (1, confidence medium): s05:drivers/virt/fsl_hypervisor.c:218-240, quote 'num_pages = (param.count + lb_offset + PAGE_SIZE - 1) >> PAGE_SHIFT;'. ioctl_memcpy() on /dev/fsl-hv (FSL_HV_IOCTL_MEMCPY) copies a userspace-controlled struct fsl_hv_ioctl_memcpy via copy_from_user (line 165); the only validation (lines 218-220) is param.count == 0 || param.count > U64_MAX - lb_offset - PAGE_SIZE + 1 — a 64-bit wraparound guard only. num_pages is 'unsigned int' (line 155) and receives the 64-bit expression truncated to 32 bits with no clamp (line 221); the allocation at lines 239-240 'kmalloc(num_pages * sizeof(struct fh_sg_list) + sizeof(struct fh_sg_list) - 1, GFP_KERNEL)' is a plain 32-bit multiply-add (element 32 bytes, struct fh_sg_list, arch/powerpc/include/asm/fsl_hcalls.h) with no kcalloc/array_size overflow check, and pages = kcalloc(num_pages, ...) at line 229 is sized by the same truncated count. Unsafe use: get_user_pages_fast(..., num_pages, ..., pages) at 249-250 and the fill loop 'for (i = 1; i < num_pages; i++)' at line 274 writes sg_list[i].source/.target/.size (lines 277-287) into the under-sized buffer, then fh_partition_memcpy(..., virt_to_phys(sg_list), num_pages) at 290-291. E.g. param.count near 2^41 gives num_pages 2^29 whose 32-bit product 2^34 wraps to 0, so kmalloc(31) succeeds while the loop writes num_pages elements — the seed's truncate->under-allocate->element-indexed-loop heap OOB write chain under a local-ioctl attacker. Limitations: requires root-owned /dev/fsl-hv on Freescale powerpc, a successful page pin of num_pages pages, and no runtime reproducer was built (read-only tree).

CANDIDATES: 14 classified — 2 reported (fsl_hypervisor.c:239 allocator, :274 consuming loop), 11 safe with concrete counter-evidence (fbcmap.c:94 clamped by fb_set_user_cmap 'size < 0 || size < cmap->len -> -E2BIG' at 269-272; enetc_cbdr.c:9 constant bd_count; pvrdma_mr.c:213 clamped to PVRDMA_MAX_FAST_REG_PAGES=128 at line 217; gve_adminq.c:811 kernel-derived num_entries; vringh.c:1295 no alloc, ring-capacity-bounded; stm32-adc.c:1906, fat/dir.c:1339, bond_alb.c:128, pci/quirks.c:5289, amd/pmc.c:200, sli4.c:4176 all constant or locally-derived multipliers), 1 unresolved (seed usbip chain verbatim unpatched at usbip_common.c:578-579/591, excluded-by-rule per seed-never-reportable). Bounded sweep: narrow-typed 'size = count * sizeof' assignments plus raw '* sizeof' allocator arguments (128 hits enumerated) across drivers/fs/net/block/sound/crypto; remaining raw-multiply hits and count<<shift forms were not exhaustively audited after the finalize directive.
